title: CloudPanel import
description: Move sites from a CloudPanel server to this one: connect the old server, upload its scan report, then create and copy the sites.
copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. Select the text and copy it by hand.

source.title: Old server
source.intro: Hostashi reads the sites over SSH from the CloudPanel server. It only reads there and changes nothing.
source.introNotReady: The connection is not ready yet: finish the steps below.
source.addressHint: Prefer the IP address: DNS names move during the migration.
source.authorizedKeys: On the old server, add this line to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys. It only allows reading files over SFTP and a tunnel to its database.
source.forgetText: Forget the old server? Its key and host key are deleted here. Remove the line from authorized_keys there as well.
source.badHost: Use an IP address or a lowercase DNS name.

hostKey.title: Host key of the old server
hostKey.missing: The old server's SSH host key is not confirmed yet. Nothing is copied until it is.
hostKey.presents: The old server presents {{fingerprint}}. On the old server, run this and trust the key only if one line shows the same fingerprint:

db.sqlTitle: Run this SQL on the old server now
db.sqlText: Run it as the MariaDB administrator there, for example in <code1>mysql</code1> as root. It creates the user <code2>{{user}}</code2> that may only read. Hostashi shows it only this once.
db.title: Database access
db.readAs: Databases are read as {{user}} on the old server.
db.needUser: To copy databases, Hostashi needs a read-only database user on the old server. Files are copied without it.
db.newPasswordText: A new password replaces the old one. Run the new SQL on the old server, or database copies fail.

reports.title: Scan reports
reports.intro: Run the scan on the old server as root. It only reads the CloudPanel configuration.
reports.deleteText: Delete this report? Sites created from it stay.

tls.reissue: New certificate after the DNS switch

plan.title: Plan
plan.from: From the report uploaded <time/>. It is worked out again on every view, so sites created here show as created.
plan.notReady: Imports can start once the old server and its host key are set up.
plan.open: Open a site to create it here and copy it.

site.wwwRedirect: · taken over as the site's www redirect (to the www name)
site.nonWwwRedirect: · taken over as the site's www redirect (to the name without www)
site.cronPaused_one: {{count}} cron job was created paused. Start it after the DNS switch.
site.cronPaused_other: {{count}} cron jobs were created paused. Start them after the DNS switch.
site.proxyNoAccount: A reverse proxy site has no Linux account here: there are no files or databases to copy.
site.nodeStopped: The app stays stopped. After the final sync, set its start command on the site's Web tab.
site.pythonStopped: The app stays stopped. After the final sync, install its packages into ~/.venv over SSH and set its start command on the site's Web tab.

create.confirmChecked: Confirm that you checked the points above.
create.intro: The site gets the old domains without a certificate. HTTPS follows after the DNS switch.
create.nodeHint: The old Node.js version is not known. The app stays stopped until you set its start command.
create.pythonHint: The old Python version is not known. Hostashi makes the environment ~/.venv; install the packages into it after the copy. The app stays stopped until you set its start command.
create.proxy: It passes every request on to {{target}}, without a Linux account, files or cron jobs.
create.poolHint: Where the site's home lives. A site stays on its pool.
create.poolTooSmall: Pool {{pool}} has less free space than the old home uses. Choose another pool.
create.pageCache: Switch on the page cache ({{preset}} preset)
create.wordpress: The site gets the WordPress profile: <code1>xmlrpc.php</code1> is blocked, PHP never runs in <code2>wp-content/uploads</code2>, and <code3>wp-login.php</code3> is rate limited. Change the rules on the site's Hardening tab after the import.
create.reviewed: I checked the points above for {{name}}

import.intro: The site exists here. The import copies the old files to cloudpanel-import in its home and leaves the web root as it is. Run it again shortly before the DNS switch for the final sync.
import.databasesHint: One per line: the database on the old server, a space, the database of this site here.
import.createFirst: Create the databases on the Databases page first.
import.label: Import of {{name}}

loads.title: Database loads
loads.soon: The dumps are loaded into the databases shortly.

activate.done: The imported files are the web root of {{site}} now. The old web root is kept as {{previous}} in its home.
activate.label: Use imported files for {{site}}
activate.text: Make the imported files the web root of {{site}}? Do this after the final sync, before the DNS switch. The current web root is kept and nothing is deleted.
activate.button: Use imported files as web root

snippets.intro_one: The old site has {{count}} custom nginx directive. Review it once: the draft leaves out what Hostashi does itself and points paths at this server.
snippets.intro_other: The old site has {{count}} custom nginx directives. Review them once: the draft leaves out what Hostashi does itself and points paths at this server.
snippets.serverHint: Check every line once before you save.
snippets.rootHint: From the old site's location /, without its try_files.

dbMap.pair: write the old database, a space and the database here.

errors.invalid_report: This is not a valid scan report: {{message}}. Create it with hostashi cloudpanel scan -json -full.
errors.too_large: The report is larger than 16 MiB.
errors.too_many_reports: At most 20 reports are kept. Delete one first.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The report must be a JSON file.
errors.not_done: The import has not finished copying yet.
errors.needs_review: Confirm that you checked this site first.
errors.pool_unusable: The storage pool cannot take this site: its volume is missing or it has too little free space. Choose another pool.
errors.no_site: The report has no importable site of this name. Reload the page.
errors.not_found: This report or import does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.no_source: Set up the old server first.
errors.unreachable: The old server did not answer over SSH. Check the address, the port and its firewall.
errors.unavailable: Importing is not available on this panel.
errors.site_exists: A site with this name exists here already.
errors.domain_taken: A domain of this site belongs to another site here.
errors.agent_timeout: The server did not answer in time. Reload the page to see whether the change was made.
errors.agent_unavailable: The change could not be completed. Try again.

cutoverErrors.cutover_running: A DNS check of this site is running already. Reload the page.
cutoverErrors.site_state: The site does not exist here or is disabled. Enable it first.
cutoverErrors.not_found: The DNS check is not available on this panel.
